scope.exists: This project already exists — reusing it.
coverage.via_redirect: {lang}: article “{title}” (the Wikidata link pointed to a redirect).
coverage.section: {lang}: no separate article — the topic is covered inside “{title}”.
coverage.proxy: {lang}: stand-in article “{title}” (a different Wikidata item, chosen explicitly).
coverage.disambiguation: {lang}: the link leads to a disambiguation page “{title}”.
coverage.extra: {lang}: +{n} related article(s) in the topic basket.
ask.which_topic: “{topic}” can mean several things. Which one should be analysed?
ask.missing: {lang} {source} has no article on “{label}”. What should be done?
ask.bad_title: “{title}” is not usable in {lang} ({reason}). Choose another title:
ask.wiktionary: Wiktionary tracks single words, not topics. Which word should be tracked in each language?
opt.own: Use another article — replace <title> with the exact title
ask.no_main: {lang} has no main article yet, so “{title}” cannot be added as a related article. What should be done?
opt.choose_main: Choose a main article — replace <title> with the exact title
note.lang_alias: “{typed}” is not a wiki language code; using “{lang}” ({name}).
note.set_checked: {lang}: “{title}” checked — it begins: “{extract}”. Confirm with the user that this is the intended topic.
note.section: {lang}: the numbers describe the broader article “{title}”, not only this topic.
note.proxy: {lang}: “{title}” is a stand-in article; trust will be capped at medium.
note.stale: The project changed after the last analysis — run the analysis again.
reason.spike_driven: most views come from one-off spikes
reason.verify_flips: the robustness check reverses the verdict
reason.low_volume: few views (under 300 a month), percentages are noisy
reason.spiky: a fifth to a half of views come from spikes
reason.data_incident: a known Wikimedia data problem overlaps the compared years
reason.redirect_coverage: part of the traffic arriving via redirects is not counted
reason.dominant_redirect: one redirect carries over 30% of the traffic
reason.young_article: the article is young; early months are excluded
reason.renamed: the article was renamed during the period
reason.project_shift: the whole language edition changed by over 25% in a year
reason.trend_conflict: the long-term trend disagrees with the yearly change
reason.verify_weakens: the verdict weakens under alternative calculations
reason.proxy: a stand-in article is used, not the exact topic
say.lang: {lang}: {share} views per million; year over year {g} (90% CI {ci}) — {verdict}; trust: {trust}.
say.lang_nogrowth: {lang}: {share} views per million; yearly change cannot be measured (under 2 years of data); trust: {trust}.
say.missing: {lang}: no article on this topic — no data (a possible content gap).
say.context: {lang}: the whole edition changed {proj} in a year; the topic's raw views {raw}; its share {g}.
say.countries: {lang}: readers of this edition are mostly in {list} (whole edition, last 12 months).
say.spike_geo: {lang}: spike on {day} — {share} of its views in this edition came from {country}.
say.spike_geo_other: {lang}: the same day readers from {country} also opened the article in {others}.
caveat.interest_not_demand: Pageviews show curiosity, not willingness to pay: treat the results as leads for further validation.
caveat.lang_not_country: A language edition is not a country: its readers live in several countries, and one country reads several editions.
caveat.short_period: The yearly change always compares the last 12 months with the 12 months before, even when a shorter period was requested.
caveat.young: {lang}: the article was created on {created}; the analysis starts on {start}.
caveat.renamed: {lang}: renamed on {day} (“{source}” → “{target}”); both titles are counted.
caveat.dominant_redirect: {lang}: the redirect “{title}” carries a large share of the traffic; it is counted.
caveat.unchecked_redirects: {lang}: {n} redirect(s) could not be checked and are not counted.
caveat.geo_skipped: The country breakdown of spikes was skipped (offline or unavailable).
caveat.countries_skipped: Readers by country were skipped (offline and not in the cache).
caveat.geo_threshold: {lang}: spike on {day} — no country passed Wikimedia's publication threshold (about 90 views a day from one country).
caveat.geo_unpublished: {lang}: country data for the spike on {day} is not published yet.
caveat.countries_rounded: Country figures are Wikimedia's rounded upper bounds.
caveat.bh: With {n} languages, trend p-values are corrected for multiple comparisons (Benjamini–Hochberg).
next.verify: Check how robust the verdicts are
next.publish: Copy {template} to notes.md, fill it in, then build the report
caveat.more: More sentences and caveats are in analysis.json (files.data).
next.continue: The download is not finished — run the same command again
analyze.almost: All languages are downloaded, but reader countries are not finished — run the same command again.
analyze.partial: Data downloaded for {done} of {total} language(s); run the same command again to continue.
notes.instructions: Write in the user's language. Use ONLY numbers that appear in the facts below. At most 3 sentences per section. Keep the headings.
